# v5.0.1 — Modules 1–5 Alignment

This patch release harmonizes the navigation and overview layer across all five completed modules without changing the underlying curriculum scope.

## Included

- one shared module-overview contract across Modules 1–5
- one shared section-overview contract across all 20 completed sections
- aligned learning outcomes, paths, working-data/visual guidance, and study guidance
- missing Module 1 dataset index plus calculation indexes for Modules 4 and 5
- expanded Module 2 dataset index
- corrected Module 5 published-release status
- stronger repository validation for shared lesson, overview, review, and resource-index contracts

## Quality intent

The release aligns the learning experience while preserving the repository's existing rule that visuals, process flows, examples, calculations, and lesson presentation should be **topic-appropriate rather than mechanically identical**.
